d: THE SOLDATS, flowing from all sides to the sound of the drum, with a prolonged bearing.
The same, TONIO, with the French cocard with his cap.
The Same, SULPICE and MARIE, coming out of the cottage
The same, THE MARQUISE, coming out of your cottage.
MARIE, SOLDATS entering tumultuously from all sides and grouping around Mary.
THE MARQUISE, A VALET that successively brings in the guests. THE NOTE, THE DUCHESSE. One hears a waltz under the windows of the castle.
The same, then TONIO, THE SOLDATES
